title: The Riches of Bunyan: Selected from His Works
author: John Bunyan

authorInfo.bio: John Bunyan was an English writer and nonconformist preacher. He is best remembered as the author of the Christian allegory The Pilgrim's Progress, which also became an influential literary model. In addition to The Pilgrim's Progress, Bunyan wrote nearly sixty titles, many of them expanded sermons.

sourceTitle: The Riches of Bunyan: Selected from His Works
description: "The Riches of Bunyan: Selected from His Works" by John Bunyan is a theological compilation written in the mid-19th century. This collection seeks to highlight the profound thoughts and insights of Bunyan, known for his deep piety and vivid prose, particularly focusing on topics such as the nature of God, sin, human redemption, and the Christian experience.
